Subject: MAP Kickoff — stakeholder rollcall, roles & ops handoff (calendar + Zoom)

Hi Evan / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. To keep momentum toward your Q3 launch and the close timeline we discussed, let’s get a short MAP kickoff on the calendar next week to align owners, evaluation scenarios, and ops details (Zoom, access, and attachments).

Proposed 30-minute window: Thu 2026-05-20, 10:00–10:30 PT. If that doesn't work, share alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Agenda (draft):
- Quick intros & roles (5 min)
- MAP objectives, success criteria & close timeline (7 min)
- Evaluation plan: scenarios & data access (10 min)
- Ops: Zoom, test accounts, docs & next steps (5 min)

Attached: MAP-draft-20260512.pdf (high-level milestones) and a compact evaluation-scenarios spreadsheet.

Ben (CS lead) and Marissa (solutions) are copied to confirm availability and handle Ops walk-through. Karthik will own the evaluation test cases from the customer side.

Action items for the kickoff: please confirm attendees and nominate any additional stakeholders (security, procurement) to include.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett

+1 415-555-0132
